title: Antim : The Final Truth
desc: A poor farmer's son rises in the city as a fearless gangster, but his reign is challenged when an unyielding cop steps in, sparking a fierce battle of power and justice.

title: Zee Tunes
desc: Learn Dance with Zee Tunes on your favorite Bollywood songs.

title: Andha Kanoon
desc: Witnesses to the killing of his parents by three men called Amar, Akbar and Anthony, Vijay teams up with a former forest officer to take revenge.

title: I Want To Talk
desc: Arjun, a marketing executive in America, struggles with his daughter. His life changes when he is diagnosed with throat cancer, forcing him to confront relationships, words, and mortality.

title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
desc: Keshav marries Jaya and adores her, but their happiness falters when she protests the lack of a toilet at home. As tensions rise, he struggles to appease her with temporary fixes.

title: Murder Mubarak
desc: During a murder probe, an unconventional cop digs into a diverse pool of suspects, stepping into their worlds as an outsider, only to uncover hidden motives and layers far beyond the obvious.

title: Koogle Kuttappa
desc: A conservative villager opposes his son's move to Russia for work, but when the son brings home a robot caregiver, he forms an unexpected bond with the machine.

title: Vedaa
desc: Vedaa, facing caste discrimination, trains as a boxer under Abhimanyu to seek justice for her siblings' murder, fighting both societal bias and the killers with courage and determination.

title: Khatron Ke Khiladi
desc: Balwant, an honest truck driver, is pulled into a life of crime while seeking revenge for his brother's death. But as his actions spiral, his children step in to stop him and bring him back.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Tigers : Can A Salesman Be A Hero
desc: A pharma salesman in Pakistan takes on his own company after discovering they knowingly marketed harmful baby formula, risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Sadhu Aur Shaitan
desc: Sher Khan robs a bank, frames Sadhuram, then dies. His body is found in Bajrang's taxi. Both Sadhuram and Bajrang run from police after being blamed.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: A former nursing student from Kerala becomes a terrorist's wife. She recounts her journey from innocence to radicalisation, revealing the dark truth behind her transformation.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: Waris
desc: Disillusioned by the king's tyranny, the queen leaves with her son. Years later, upon the king's death, officials search for the heir to claim the throne.
